items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: He was a guitar player. We had Benny Turner on piano. And we had, uh, Earl Barnes on clarinet... And, uh, we had, uh, myself on bass.

ctx.x: He was a guitar player. We had Benny Turner on piano. And we had, uh, Earl Barnes on clarinet. I'm not playing the saxophone. Is that Paul?
